name: EmptyState
title: EmptyState
summary: A centred panel that explains why a list, search or screen has nothing to show and offers the one next step.
whenToUse: Use when a search returns no results: suggest close matches as chips.
Use when a personal collection is empty for the first time (saved verses, downloads, favourite stations): offer the action that fills it.
Use when content cannot load because the reader is offline or the request failed: offer Retry.
whenNotToUse: Do not use while content is still loading; use Loader skeletons.
Do not use for a whole-site error page; that is the 404 page pattern.

anatomy.description: Icon circle (64px) + title + one short sentence + one next step (chips, a primary button, or a secondary Retry).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`nothing`: first-time empty collection (blue icon, one primary button).
`noResults`: search with no hits (neutral icon, suggestion chips; announced politely).
`error`: offline or failed load (red tint, secondary "Try again"; announced once with `role="alert"`).

props.name: title
props.description: Heading text, for example "No saved verses yet".

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level that fits the page outline.

props.name: children
props.description: The one short sentence: what happened and what to do. Never blame the reader.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the 28px icon. Defaults to bookmark, search or wifi-off by variant. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the single next-step button, for example "Start reading" or "Try again".

props.name: onAction
props.description: Click handler of the next-step button.

props.name: actionHref
props.description: Render the next step as a link to this URL instead of a button.

props.name: actionIcon
props.description: Trailing icon of the action, for example a refresh icon on "Try again". Defaults to a refresh icon for `error`.

props.name: chips
props.description: `noResults` only: two to four `.chip` suggestions (real searches the reader can tap).

props.name: variant
props.description: `noResults` (grey search icon, suggestion chips), `nothingYet` (blue tint, one primary action), `offline` (red tint, secondary "Try again").

props.name: description
props.description: One short sentence saying what to do. Never blames the reader.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon override. Defaults: search, bookmark, wifi-off.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the single next-step button.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the next-step button is pressed.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Two to four real searches the reader can tap (`noResults`).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the description, replacing the default action.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Panel `--white`, 1px `--gray-200` border, radius `--radius-lg`, padding 40px 28px, everything centred.
One next step only. "Nothing yet" gets the single Horizon Blue primary; offline uses a secondary button so it never competes with the page's primary.
Suggestion chips are real searches the reader can tap; 44px tall from `.chip`.
Icons: 28px inline SVG, stroke currentColor, 1.8 width, round caps.
Inside a list or card, the empty state replaces the list in place; keep the page header and filters visible.
Red tint only for offline and errors. Never use it for an empty collection.
Link icons on the action: ↗ when it goes to another page, › when it drills into an app screen.

dont: Do not use while content is still loading; use Loader skeletons.
Do not use for a whole-site error page; that is the 404 page pattern.
accessibility: Use a real heading (`h2`/`h3`) at the level that fits the page outline.
When results update to empty after a search, announce it: wrap in or update a `role="status"` region ("No results for psalm 151").
Offline and load errors use `role="alert"` once, when they appear.
After Retry, move focus to the first loaded item or keep it on the button if it fails again.
Icons are `aria-hidden="true"`; the title and sentence carry the meaning.
Chips and buttons are 44px tap targets with the base focus ring.
content: Say what happened and what to do. Never blame the reader ("You typed it wrong").
No results: echo the query. "No results for “psalm 151”. Check the spelling, or try one of these:" + Psalm 23, Psalms, dot.Bible app.
Nothing yet: invite. "No saved verses yet. Tap the bookmark on any verse and it will wait for you here." + Start reading.
Offline: reassure. "You’re offline. Check your connection and try again. Bibles you’ve downloaded still work." + Try again.
Keep it warm and short. No jokes, no emoji, no exclamation marks.

html:
No saved verses yet

Tap the bookmark on any verse and it will wait for you here.
